digest.component_or_area: live Jira Data Center integration tests
propositions: The test assertion scans json.dumps(ticket) with a case-sensitive substring search for the raw Jira key, but the local ticket id is lowercased via _jira_key_to_local_id, making the match impossible.

The ticket payload created by _inbound_create_write_create_event does not contain the raw Jira key; it only appears as a title fallback when no summary exists, leaving no raw key in the JSON for the assertion to find.

The Jira key to local id correspondence is recorded exclusively in the binding store, which list_tickets does not return, so the assertion cannot verify the DC↔local mapping that the acceptance criterion requires.

The test must assert on the exact local ticket id derived from _jira_key_to_local_id(remote_key) and validate the binding store contains the correct mapping to prove an inbound-created ticket appears in the local store.
